g.text: A disciplined five-stage progression from hackathon functional prototype to enterprise eRTMAC decision support layer.
Ingested 18+ public NLOG borehole records and well metadata tables.
Unified coordinate datums to WGS84 for accurate Haversine distance math.
Curated realistic prototype wells (X03–X21) honoring Assam-Arakan geology.
Established clean schemas for Measured Depth (MD) and TVD conversions.
Integrated Tesseract.js client-side parser to digitize scanned DDR/WCR reports.
Implemented rule-based extraction for kicks, severe losses, and tight hole events.
Deterministic 4-variable scoring prioritizing highest-value offset wells.
Dynamic depth projection (+100m) with direct evidence citations & Copilot QA.
Conduct structured workshops with OIL drilling engineers to calibrate formula.
Verify formation marker naming and fault boundaries with subsurface team.
Establish alert sensitivity limits to eliminate alert fatigue in rig operations.
Align hazard mitigations with Oil India standard drilling operating procedures.
Replay 5–10 recently completed OIL wells with documented NPT incidents in sandbox.
Measure advance warning lead time (hours/meters) generated ahead of real past kicks.
Evaluate usability with active shift engineers during morning planning sessions.
Standardize Intelligence Brief formatting to match OIL daily reporting protocols.
Connect live WITSML 1.4/2.0 telemetry from active rigs directly into NWIS.
Display historical hazard look-ahead directly alongside real-time eRTMAC displays.
Deploy securely on OIL private enterprise cloud or on-premise Duliajan datacenter.
Scale system across 20+ active drilling rigs simultaneously across northeast basins.
Requires no supercomputing or specialized GPU clusters. Operates on standard workstation hardware via lightweight FastAPI and browser-based client inference.
Full on-premise execution ensures sensitive well completion reports, formation tops, and incident logs never egress Oil India's secure enterprise perimeter.
Designed to sit alongside existing eRTMAC screens without displacing current monitoring workflows or altering rig-site reporting chains of command.
Preventing a single stuck pipe incident or severe circulation loss event saves ₹25L–₹1 Cr in rig downtime, immediately recovering full deployment investment.
